Rust/compiler/Vec/Clone and rpds ordered-map/persistent-snapshot contracts are premises. Source hashes bind a reviewed mapping, not verified Rust extraction. No allocation, panic, lock or Raft proof.

source_mapping.as_slice: decode; len bounds established by private construction
source_mapping.Eq_Ord_Borrow: All explicitly delegate to the same byte slice; no enum-derived ordering
source_mapping.engine: Only private CfMap key, owned range bounds, output byte conversion and borrowed delete argument differ; refusal/revision/locks and all other engine source bytes unchanged
